catalysts.headline: Moderna announced it will report Q3 2026 financial results on Friday, November 6, 2026, with a conference call at 8:00am ET

Juan Andres returns to Moderna as Chief Operating Officer overseeing manufacturing, as the company adds a COO role ahead of the potential launch/scale-up of intismeran autogene; Jerh Collins (chief technical operations and quality officer) is retiring
Unexplained +8.6% intraday move, no identified same-day company-specific news (carried from baseline)

Merck/Moderna Phase 3 INTerpath-001 trial (intismeran autogene / mRNA-4157/V940 + Keytruda) met primary (RFS) and key secondary (DMFS) endpoints in resected Stage IIB-IV melanoma -- first positive Phase 3 readout for an individualized mRNA cancer therapy
catalysts.impact: stock up ~143%-177% over the following month per various sources (recorded as found, not reconciled)

catalysts.headline: FDA PDUFA goal date for the mRNA-1010 seasonal flu vaccine BLA; an FDA advisory committee had voted unanimously in June 2026 that its benefits outweigh its risks for adults 50 and older, but the outcome of the agency's decision on this goal date was not found or confirmed in sources reachable this session
Moderna paid $950 million related to a litigation settlement, following a $0.9B non-recurring charge to cost of sales flagged in the Q1 2026 update
catalysts.note: month-level precision only; exact day not found this session

catalysts.headline: An FDA advisory committee voted unanimously that the mRNA-1010 seasonal flu vaccine's benefits outweigh its risks for adults 50 and older
catalysts.note: month-level precision only; exact day not found this session

catalysts.headline: The European Union approved mCOMBRIAX (mRNA-1083, a combined flu/COVID-19 vaccine) for adults 50 and older — Moderna's fourth authorized EU product; the company is still awaiting FDA guidance before refiling the combination vaccine in the US
catalysts.note: month-level precision only; exact day not found this session

conflicts: Market cap: one Equibles snapshot shows $69.62B at $133.32/share (2026-08-20, described as a -23.55% move that day); a separate Equibles summary shows $23.97B at $60.42/share; Fintel reports a $22.66B market cap dated 2026-08-03; a separate quote point cites $160.73/share as of 2026-09-17, which at ~397M shares would imply a market cap well above all of these. None of these could be reconciled to a single current figure — this spread looks like it reflects data-quality problems in the aggregators as much as genuine disagreement, but it could not be resolved this session (WebFetch to live quote sources failed, and the shared WebSearch budget for this task batch was exhausted before a follow-up query could be run).
Shares outstanding: Equibles shows both 396,786,259 and 396,586,862 on different pages; Fintel uses roughly 399 million — not reconciled, not averaged.

Short interest: Bank of America's equity team reportedly put Moderna's short interest at 17.8% of float, calling it the most-shorted S&P 500 stock (article undated); a later Equibles snapshot instead shows ~49.8M shares short, or 12.5% of float, 10.2 days to cover, with short interest described as falling. A prior PM-pass record separately carried conflicting figures of 13.13% of shares outstanding vs 13.5% of free float vs ~20% of float across three other sources. None of these are reconciled here.

Cash asOf date: the prior PM-pass record listed Moderna's $6.9B cash figure as 'asOf 2026-09-14'; this session's primary-source check (the Q2 2026 earnings release) ties that same $6.9B balance to June 30, 2026 — flagging this as a likely date-labeling error in the prior record rather than a genuine new conflict.
notes: Theme 'Biotech Catalyst' is a good fit and is kept as-is — Moderna is a commercial-stage biotech whose stock moves heavily on discrete regulatory and clinical catalysts (FDA decisions, trial readouts, vaccine approvals) rather than steady fundamentals. themeLabel kept as 'story stock' given the heavy short interest and catalyst-driven volatility the theme name itself implies. The Q2 2026 earnings report's exact calendar date could not be pinned down this session (only the quarter and headline figures were confirmed), so it is described in the fundamentals/eps sections above but intentionally left out of the dated catalysts list per the 'every catalyst needs a date' rule, rather than guessing a specific day. Market cap, float, sharesOutstanding and shortInterest could not be established to a reliable, reconciled figure this session given the scale of disagreement across aggregators (see conflicts) combined with WebFetch failing against every external site attempted (SEC EDGAR, Yahoo Finance, MarketWatch all returned DNS/connectivity errors in this sandbox) and the shared WebSearch budget for this task batch being exhausted before these could be independently re-checked against a single authoritative source.
